episodes.source_obstruction: A near-complete local component plus negligible remainder can carry the same global obligation as the full quantity.
episodes.transformation: Run an obligation-strength/DifferenceWitness audit before estimation; if endpoint inclusion collapses locality, cut before the endpoint.
known_breakpoints: strict interior path statistics need not determine the endpoint
one-sided path functionals differ from two-sided O(n^A) classes

episodes.source_obstruction: Conditional source-order series cannot be glued from independently treated windows without an order/block-tail witness.
episodes.transformation: Use finite contiguous source-order cuts and retain the complementary suffix/tail as an explicit gluing obligation.
known_breakpoints: a finite source-order decomposition is legal but says nothing about size of the suffix

order: apply R6 strength audit to reject endpoint-inclusive Q as presumptively root-coupled
apply R4 source-order transformation to cut strictly at Y_n<X_n
retain suffix drawdown G_n(Y_n,X_n) and external tail E_n(X_n) as separate residuals
prove only the exact Q+G+E endpoint inequality before any arithmetic estimate
interface_obligations: same Coffey natural order and normalization
path-space DifferenceWitness is not mislabeled as arithmetic attainability
